status: read-only host planning; not a deployment authorization or execution
observed_contract: Release directory is selected by ZIP SHA256. Existing named launcher links are accepted only when their targets already equal that same release. A different target returns existing launcher differs; an explicit upgrade/repair plan is required. These guards are unchanged.
decision: Do not run the ordinary installer expecting an upgrade, weaken the guard, remove existing launchers or automatically mutate them. The requested reboot comes first. Any later deployment needs an explicit exact-hash owned-link upgrade/cutover plan, fresh device preservation preflight and recorded approval. Preserve old immutable release, config/state/trust, prototypes and unrelated extensions. No live host service changes are needed merely to reason about this guard.
